fields.caption_bottom: Explain an Anthropic S-1 without becoming a securities lawyer.

narrative_summary: A pastel blob discovers that the mysterious title “Anthropic S-1” is not a new model name but a legal boss fight.
rationale: Candidate 2 turns the S-1’s legal nature into a clear obstacle instead of merely repeating that the headline is confusing. The One Does Not Simply template fits the impossible-task premise, and “without becoming a securities lawyer” provides the strongest comic turn.
